arts.ttl: Idrissa Gueye Breaks Silence After Everton Red Card vs Man Utd
arts.sum: Idrissa Gueye Has Broken His Silence After Red Card For Striking Everton Teammate vs Man Utd

arts.ttl: Will Man United ever change? Another missed chance under Amorim on dismal night vs. Everton
arts.sum: Exactly one year after Ruben Amorim's arrival, Manchester United had their latest chance to prove they had turned a corner. They couldn't.

arts.ttl: Ten-man Everton beat Man United 1-0 despite Gueye’s red card for striking a teammate
arts.sum: Everton beat Manchester United 1-0 on Monday to slow the home team’s recent revival in a Premier League game that will be remembered for an early red card shown to Everton’s Idrissa Gueye for striking teammate Michael Keane. “The referee’s call of red card to Gueye for violent conduct was checked and confirmed by VAR — with the action deemed to be a clear strike to the face of Keane,” the league said in a social media post.

arts.ttl: Ruben Amorim reveals his biggest concern for Manchester United after 'really bad' loss to Everton
arts.sum: Man Utd’s unbeaten run comes to an end on Ruben Amorim’s one-year anniversary

arts.ttl: Everton star Idrissa Gueye breaks silence after slapping teammate in Man Utd win
arts.sum: Idrissa Gueye was sent off for slapping his Everton team-mate Michael Keane just 13 minutes into the Premier League clash against Manchester United at Old Trafford

arts.ttl: Man United 0-1 Everton: Post-Match Man United Player Ratings
arts.sum: Manchester United fell to a disappointing 1-0 defeat at Old Trafford against Everton in a game that Ruben Amorim will feel his side needed to win. The Dutchman had a reasonably straightforward night in the backline after Everton's red card limited their attacks.

arts.ttl: Man Utd 0-1 Everton: Dewsbury-Hall spares Gueye's blushes as Everton win madcap game
arts.sum: When David Moyes took his seat in the dugout at the start of the evening, surely the last thing the Everton manager would have expected to see was one of his players being sent for an early shower after fighting with a team-mate. Mbuemo had cut inside to present Bruno Fernandes with the home team’s first shooting chance that he sent wide only for Gueye to stride over to Keane and start berating his team-mate.

arts.ttl: Gary Neville slams 'embarrassing' Man Utd moment as Ruben Amorim decision questioned vs Everton
arts.sum: Gary Neville criticised one moment in particular as Manchester United were beaten 1-0 by Everton on Monday night in the Premier League

arts.ttl: What Jack Grealish did at full-time vs Man Utd after Idrissa Gueye and Michael Keane spat
arts.sum: Everton defeated Man Utd with ten-men after Idrissa Gueye was sent off for slapping his Toffees' teammate Michael Keane round the face

arts.ttl: 'A waste of time': Luke Shaw singled out by Gary Neville during Manchester United loss to Everton
arts.sum: Gary Neville felt the Man Utd defender could have offered much more as hosts chased an equaliser against Everton
